trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

entries: The wurm makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Morsure

If la cible is a Large or smaller creature, it doit réussir on a {@dd 22}Dextérité saving throw or be swallowed by the wurm. Si  wurm takes 30dgts or more on a single turn from une créature inside it, the wurm doit réussir on a {@dd 22}jet de sauvegarde Constitution at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 mètres of the wurm and has the {@condition à terre} condition. Si  wurm dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition entravé} condition and can escape from the corpse by using 10 mètres of movement, exiting with the {@condition à terre} condition.

This transformation lasts for 1 heure or until la créature drops to 0touché points in its new form.

action.name: Shattered Shards
entries: The witch targets a point it can see within 30 mètres of itself. The air there magically solidifies into a mirrorlike pane, then shatters in a 15-foot cone originating from that point. Each creature in that area doit faire a {@dd 16}Dextérité saving throw, taking 25 ({@dégât 10d4}) forcedgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one.

entries: The faerie summons a 30-foot-radius sphere of magical light centered on itself, which lasts for 1 minute or until the faerie has the {@condition incapacitated} condition. Each creature of the faerie's choice (other than the faerie) that starts its turn in that area gains 5 temporary hit points and has advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Wisdom checks until the start of its next turn.

The sphere is bright light, sheds dim light for an additional 30 feet, and moves with the faerie. If any of the sphere's area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled.

entries: The specter uses Mournful Keening if available, then makes one Hooves attack and one Reaping Scythe attack.

action.name: Sabots
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}16 ({@dégât 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoningdgts plus 28 ({@dégât 8d6}) necroticdgts. If la cible is a Medium or smaller creature, it doit réussir on a {@dd 18}Force saving throw or have the {@condition à terre} condition.

action.name: Mournful Keening {@recharge}
entries: The specter utters a keening wail, calling to those close to death. Each non-Undead creature within 120 mètres of the specter doit faire a {@dd 15}jet de sauvegarde Constitution. On a failure, la créature hears the wail and is marked for death.

A creature marked for death can't regaintouché points, désavantage on death saving throws, and all attack rolls against it are made with advantage. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until la créature is targeted by a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic.

action.name: Reaping Scythe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}12 ({@dégât 1d12 + 6}) slashingdgts plus 28 ({@dégât 8d6}) necroticdgts. If la cible is une créature, it doit réussir on a {@dd 15}jet de sauvegarde Constitution or gain a level of {@condition épuisement}.

trait.name: Caramelization
entries: Si  horror takes firedgts, it releases a sweet, mesmerizing scent. Each creature within 30 mètres of the horror doit réussir on a {@dd 11}Sagesse saving throw or have the {@condition charmé} condition. A {@condition charmé} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Résistance à la magie
entries: The horror avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The horror makes one Bite attack and two Candy Cane attacks.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}11 ({@dégât 2d6 + 4}) piercingdgts plus 10 ({@dégât 3d6}) aciddgts.

action.name: Candy Cane
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}8 ({@dégât 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoningdgts. If la cible is a Large or smaller creature, the horror can choose to deal nodgts; instead, la cible has the {@condition à terre} condition, and the horror can pull la cible up to 5 mètres toward itself.

monster.name: Tempest Hart

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: Si  hart fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hart makes a Lightning Antlers attack and a Thunder Hooves attack.

action.name: Lightning Antlers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} pour toucher, allonge 15 m,, une cible. {@h}16 ({@dégât 2d10 + 5}) lightningdgts. If la cible is une créature, it doit réussir on a {@dd 16}jet de sauvegarde Constitution or have the {@condition étourdi} condition until the start of the hart's next turn.

action.name: Thunder Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}14 ({@dégât 2d8 + 5}) thunderdgts.

reactionHeader: The hart can take up to two reactions per round but only one per turn.

reaction.name: Entangling Growth
entries: Immediately after a creature the hart can see within 120 feet of itself hits it with an attack roll, the hart reduces the damage to itself by half. The attacker must immediately make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw as beanstalks coil around it in its space. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition grappled} condition (escape {@dc 16}) and has the {@condition restrained} condition as long as it is {@condition grappled}. The beanstalks vanish after 1 minute, if the hart has the {@condition incapacitated} condition, or when the hart dies.

reaction.name: Lightning Call
entries: In response to making a saving throw, the hart calls down a bolt of lightning that targets a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 ({@damage 3d12}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The treefolk casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The treefolk avantage onDextérité ({@skill Discrétion}) checks it makes in forest terrain.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on each of its turns, the treefolk can use 10 mètres of its movement to step magically into one living tree within 5 mètres of itself and emerge from a second living tree within 60 mètres of itself that it can see, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 mètres of the second tree. Both trees must be at least as large as the treefolk.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treefolk makes two Crushing Vine attacks, two Nightshade Bolt attacks, or one of each.

action.name: Crushing Vine
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}25 ({@dégât 3d12 + 6}) bludgeoningdgts. If la cible is une créature, it has the {@condition agrippé} condition (escape {@dd 18}). While {@condition agrippé}, la créature also has the {@condition entravé} condition. The treefolk can grapple up to six creatures this way.

action.name: Nightshade Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} pour toucher, portée 60 m,, une cible. {@h}33 ({@dégât 6d10}) poisondgts.

bonus.name: Oaken Boon
entries: The treefolk blesses one creature other than itself that it can see within 60 feet of itself with the might and wisdom of the forest. While blessed in this way, a creature can use the treefolk's Tree Stride trait and gains 5 ({@dice 2d4}) temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. This blessing lasts for 1 minute, until the treefolk has the {@condition incapacitated} condition, or until the treefolk uses this bonus action again.

monster.name: Witchkite

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The witchkite casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: Si  witchkite fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The witchkite makes two Rend attacks and uses Malevolent Flare once.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}16 ({@dégât 3d6 + 6}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Malevolent Flare
entries: The witchkite spits magical, green-tinged flame at une créature it can see within 60 mètres of itself. The target doit faire a {@dd 17}Dextérité saving throw. On a failed save, la cible takes 22 ({@dégât 5d8}) firedgts and suffers one of the following effects of the witchkite's choice:

items: The target must use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature of the witchkite's choice that is within the target's reach.

entries: On a successful save, la cible takes half as muchdgts only.

reactionHeader: The witchkite can take up to two reactions per round but only one per turn.

reaction.name: Enchanting Gaze
entries: When a creature the witchkite can see moves within 10 feet of it, the witchkite emits an enchanting gaze at the creature. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and have the {@condition charmed} condition until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Retribution
entries: Immediately after taking damage from a melee attack, the witchkite makes one Rend attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Résistance à la magie
entries: The witchstalker avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Smell Magic
entries: The witchstalker can sense the presence and location of magic within 120 mètres of itself. It also avantage aux jets d'attaque against creatures that have cast a spell since the end of the witchstalker's last turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The witchstalker makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}14 ({@dégât 3d6 + 4}) piercingdgts. If la cible is a Large or smaller creature, it doit réussir on a {@dd 15}Force saving throw or have the {@condition à terre} condition.

action.name: Mind-Wracking Howl {@recharge 5}
entries: The witchstalker unleashes a terrible howl, and each creature within 30 mètres of it that isn't a Monstrosity doit faire a {@dd 13}Sagesse saving throw. On a failed save, une créature takes 24 ({@dégât 7d6}) psychicdgts and désavantage onjet de sauvegarde Constitutions to maintain {@status concentration} on spells until la fin de son prochain tour. On a successful save, une créature takes half as muchdgts only.

reaction.name: Spell Stalk
entries: Immediately after a creature within 120 feet of the witchstalker casts a spell, the witchstalker magically teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the creature and can make one Bite attack against the creature.
